scope: WP2 G/L/LRU implementation wiring on exposed P1 inputs; not full repeated P3 evaluation
split: development; both original P1 scripts already exposed; no unseen claim
changes_to_freeze: Explicit opt-in local granularity for L and LRU: independently updatable/resumable matters; no preassigned partition.
LRU: directory update selection, shared maintainer on selected bodies, independent updated-directory read selection; actual calls and errors counted.

shared.events_and_permissions: same scoped user/tool events and explicit-reference source resolver

execution: Fresh isolated run/State/memory/world/checkpoint per arm; separate phase subprocess; source held throughout all six runs.
scoring: Original complete rubric and all failures. Root additionally checks spontaneous partition, per-event submitted body candidates, actual U/A and persisted edits. No oracle State IDs or forced match to a unique partition.
representation_validity: A local arm that remains one combined card is reported as unrealized local partition, not a local-selection benefit. More card count alone does not establish semantic independence or benefit.
computational_limits: Selector calls are paid and consume the same 13-control cap. At small N, routing may cost more than all-state maintenance.
Existing directory construction still reads full Store records; only model-input body reduction is claimed when observed.
G/L/LRU are online system trajectories; later same-bank/LR controls are needed for isolated selector effects.
Shared multi-State updates are not claimed atomic in this slice.
stop_rule: Complete six runs through semantic/capacity failures; stop only for infrastructure or deterministic execution-invalidity. No broad benchmark or parameter sweep based on a successful one-off case.

validation.prepare_six_runs: PASS zero-model in /tmp; Root formal namespaces not yet prepared

local_granularity_config: control.local_granularity=true for L/LRU; ignored by G, absent key preserves historical local behavior
no_op_and_failures: Empty U with may_create=false does not force a maintenance call; the semantic no-op decision remains evaluated.
Illegal individual edits are skipped while legal independent edits may commit; pending survives mixed failure.
U or maintenance failure retains pending; A failure does not revert committed state and does not cache a failed read choice.
All controls, including selectors, share the original 13-call cap. Host can proceed with actual current observations after optional control failure.
order_rationale: New LRU decoder is encountered first for execution validity; then rotate arm order between scripts. This order was fixed before any real request, not chosen after outcomes.
source_freeze: Published source/actual config/dependencies/input hashes bound by actual prepare after publication; source unchanged throughout all six full trajectories
